labor-day-19.question: For October 19, 2026, what percent of sales went to staff labor?

args.sql: SELECT min(business_date) AS from_day, max(business_date) AS to_day, CASE WHEN count(staff_wages_cents)=count(*) AND count(staff_tax_cents)=count(*) THEN 1.0*sum(staff_wages_cents+staff_tax_cents)/nullif(sum(net_sales_cents),0) ELSE NULL END AS value, count(*)-count(staff_wages_cents) AS unknown_days FROM daily_rollups WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-10-19' AND '2026-10-19'

labor-day-19.answer: Recorded labor cost was 22% of net sales on October 19, 2026.

latte-price.question: What is the menu price of House Latte?

args.sql: SELECT CAST(data->>'price_cents' AS INTEGER) AS value FROM cv_menu WHERE data->>'name' = 'House Latte' AND status='actual'

latte-price.answer: The current menu price for House Latte is CAD 5.50.

tea-price.question: What is the current menu price for Spiced Tea?

args.sql: SELECT CAST(data->>'price_cents' AS INTEGER) AS value FROM cv_menu WHERE data->>'name' = 'Spiced Tea' AND status='actual'

cocoa-cost.question: How much does Cocoa cost us in its known recipe cost per item?

args.sql: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.price_cents, sum(r.quantity*p.cost_per_base_unit_micros)/10000.0 AS recipe_cost_cents FROM menu_items m JOIN recipe_lines r ON r.menu_item_id=m.id JOIN ingredient_prices p ON p.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE m.id='33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333' GROUP BY m.id,m.name,m.price_cents

cocoa-cost.answer: Cocoa's recorded recipe cost per item is CAD 1.90.

lowest-price.question: Which item on the active menu has the lowest current price?

args.sql: SELECT data->>'name' AS name, CAST(data->>'price_cents' AS INTEGER) AS price_cents FROM cv_menu WHERE CAST(data->>'is_active' AS TEXT) IN ('true','1') ORDER BY price_cents ASC LIMIT 1

lowest-price.answer: Morning Bun has the lowest current menu price.

highest-price.question: Which active menu item has the highest current price?

args.sql: SELECT data->>'name' AS name, CAST(data->>'price_cents' AS INTEGER) AS price_cents FROM cv_menu WHERE CAST(data->>'is_active' AS TEXT) IN ('true','1') ORDER BY price_cents DESC LIMIT 1

highest-price.answer: Cocoa has the highest current menu price.

latte-units.question: How many units of House Latte were sold on October 19, 2026?

args.sql: SELECT min(business_date) AS from_day, max(business_date) AS to_day, sum(quantity) AS value FROM cv_item_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-10-19' AND '2026-10-19' AND data->>'name' = 'House Latte'

latte-units.answer: House Latte sold 42 units on October 19, 2026.

best-margin.question: Compare House Latte, Spiced Tea, Cocoa and Morning Bun by known dollar margin per unit. Which one is highest? Compare current price against recorded recipe cost.

args.sql: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.price_cents, sum(r.quantity*p.cost_per_base_unit_micros)/10000.0 AS recipe_cost_cents FROM menu_items m JOIN recipe_lines r ON r.menu_item_id=m.id JOIN ingredient_prices p ON p.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE m.is_active GROUP BY m.id,m.name,m.price_cents ORDER BY m.name

best-margin.answer: Cocoa has the largest recorded unit margin, CA$4.35, among these items. This compares current menu prices and recorded recipe costs.
